many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    print('---',k,'H,W',H,W,'bg',bg,'3:',th,'2:',tw)

# Examine noise color clusters vs drawn shape: maybe the drawn path completes a hidden digit/glyph made of noise.
def cluster_noise(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row)
    nbg=[c for c,_ in cnt.items() if c!=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])]
    ncol=max(nbgs,key=lambda c:sum(1 for r in gi for x in r if x==c))
    th=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==3)
    tw=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==2)
    drawn=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bg and go[i][j]==3)
    noise=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==ncol)
    print('---',k,'noise=',ncol,'count',len(noise),'bg',bg)
    # bounding box of noise vs drawn
    def bb(pts):
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts];cs=[p[1] for p in pts];return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    print(' noise bbox',bb(noise))
    print(' drawn bbox',bb(drawn))
    print(' 3 bbox',bb(th),' 2 bbox',bb(tw))
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']: cluster_noise(k)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    A=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==3]
    B=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==2]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    def put(i,j): res[i][j]=3
    def isbg(i,j): return 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]==bgc
    ah=len({j for _,j in A})>1
    bh=len({j for _,j in B})>1
    if ah:
        sr=min({i for i,_ in A}); ca=sorted({j for _,j in A}); cb=sorted({j for _,j in B})
        sg=1 if cb[0]>ca[-1] else -1
        sc=min(ca) if sg==-1 else max(ca)
        print('seg1 sc init',sc,'sg',sg)
        while isbg(sr,sc+sg):
            put(sr,sc); sc+=sg
            if sc<0 or sc>=W: break
        b1=sc
        dr=1 if min({i for i,_ in B})>sr else -1
        r=sr+dr
        while isbg(r,b1):
            put(r,b1); r+=dr
        sgv=1 if min(cb)>b1 else -1
        c=b1+sgv
        while isbg(sr,c):
            put(sr,c); c+=sgv
            if c<0 or c>=W: break
    else:
        cc=min({j for _,j in A}); ra=sorted({i for i,_ in A}); rb=sorted({i for i,_ in B})
        sg=1 if rb[0]>ra[-1] else -1
        rc=min(ra) if sg==-1 else max(ra)
        print('seg1 rc init',rc,'sg',sg)
        while isbg(rc+sg,cc):
            put(rc+sg,cc); rc+=sg
            if rc<0 or rc>=H: break
        b1=rc
        dc=1 if min({j for _,j in B})>cc else -1
        c=cc+dc
        while isbg(b1,c):
            put(b1,c); c+=dc
            if c<0 or c>=W: break
        sgv=1 if min(rb)>b1 else -1
        r=b1+sgv
        while isbg(r,cc):
            put(r,cc); r+=sgv
            if r<0 or r>=H: break
    return res

import os,re,json,collections

    return G
